walkthroughs.body_html:
The cerebrum handles conscious thought.

The cerebellum coordinates muscles. The medulla controls heart rate and breathing.

Auxins: phototropism, rooting powders, weedkillers.

Gibberellins: end seed dormancy. Ethene: ripens fruit. Match a hormone to its commercial use for marks.

Type 1: injected insulin, doses matched to carbs.

Type 2: diet, exercise, drugs that raise insulin sensitivity. Risk factors: obesity, age, family history.

mcqs.q: Where do plants get most of their biomass from?
options: From carbon dioxide in the air — the carbon in plant tissue comes mostly from CO2 fixed during photosynthesis.
Insulin destroys glucose in the bloodstream so it cannot be used.
Plants get most of their mass from the soil through their roots.
Plants gain most of their mass directly from sunlight, which has weight.
